title: Small open neighbourhoods of a null set at which the measure is locally finite
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclid N with its Borel σ-algebra; for an arbitrary set S ⊆ ℝ^N, μ(S) denotes the outer measure. Let A ⊆ ℝ^N with μ(A) = 0, and suppose every x ∈ A has some r > 0 with μ(B(x, r)) < ∞, where B(x, r) is the open ball. Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is an open set O ⊆ ℝ^N with A ⊆ O and μ(O) < ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (A : Set (Euclid N)), μ A = 0 → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ μ (ball x r) ≠ ∞) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ O : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen O ∧ A ⊆ O ∧ μ O < ε
